name: HEVC Mezzanine for Vimeo
purpose: ONE 1080p file per movie, uploaded to Vimeo as the source for THEIR encoding ladder. Not watched by customers. Constraint is a predictable byte ceiling: Vimeo bills $400/TB above the 7TB included, and only the master is stored. Capped CRF pins at the ceiling on hard content and comes in UNDER on clean shows, which 2-pass structurally cannot do.

measured.host: Vultr CPU-Optimized 16 vCPU EPYC Genoa, Dallas
measured.source: BMDCA2026 BOB Dog Groups, 90s from 30:00 — worst-lighting show in the library
measured.finding: faster chosen. Dr. K compared medium vs faster side by side on two identical screens playing concurrently, on the worst-lighting source in the library, and could detect little to no difference. 1.67x faster than medium. NOTE: x265 CRF is NOT normalised across presets - a faster preset at the same CRF makes cheaper decisions and yields a SMALLER, lower-quality file. The 17% size drop is quality not kept, not efficiency gained. Acceptable here because Vimeo re-encodes the mezzanine into their own ladder. faster and veryfast were identical (36.7 vs 36.6s, same bytes) - something other than the encoder is the floor, so there is nothing below faster to gain.

concurrency.finding: Diminishing fast. Third job added 6%. Box at 15.3/16 cores. Preset change (1.67x, free) beats concurrency (1.33x, needs a worker pool). Concurrency DEFERRED.

full_length_at_medium.note: HEVC verify decode is ~15x costlier per file than H.264: 4.3 min for ONE rung vs 92s for FIVE H.264 rungs in parallel.

measured.encoders_available: No libsvt_hevc in this build. Software HEVC is libx265 and libkvazaar only; all other HEVC entries are hardware and there is no GPU on this instance. libsvtav1 IS present - AV1 unexplored, and viable for a mezzanine since Vimeo re-encodes and customer device support is irrelevant. Vimeo's acceptance of AV1 as a source is UNVERIFIED.

rules.never_upscale: Skip any rung STRICTLY ABOVE source height.
rules.master_is_top_rung: Skip a rung AT source height ONLY when the requested codec equals the master's codec. An H.264 master means 1080p HEVC is a real encode, not a skip.
rules.apple_playback: hvc1 tag is REQUIRED. Without it, a technically valid HEVC MP4 will not play on Apple devices.

rung_provenance.measured: 1080p ONLY. Measured 2026-08-18 against BMDCA2026 BOB Dog Groups, the worst-lighting show in the library. crf 25 / 6M ceiling.
rung_provenance.derived: 720p and below are DERIVED, NOT MEASURED (2026-08-20). Method: the ratio of HEVC to H.264 ceiling measured at 1080p (0.6667) applied to each H.264 rung ceiling, bufsize held at 2x the ceiling as in both presets, crf shifted by the same +3 measured at 1080p.
rung_provenance.assumption: That the 1080p HEVC/H.264 ratio holds at lower heights. It probably does NOT hold exactly - HEVC efficiency generally IMPROVES at lower bitrates, so these ceilings are likely CONSERVATIVE and real files should land under them rather than at them. That is the safe direction, and the bitrate band check will catch anything absurd.
rung_provenance.status: PROVISIONAL. Measure before any 2027 HEVC ladder is used in production.
